name: Miyagi Hayato
source:
A boy living on the island.
Appears to be Jun's childhood friend, often seen with her.
Soft-spoken and well-mannered, his attentive demeanor leaves a positive impression.
Yet perhaps due to his overly gentle nature, he constantly gets taken advantage of, leaving him overwhelmed.
